```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

# Plot a count plot for transaction types with hue as is_fraud
sns.countplot(data=df, x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', palette='coolwarm')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.title('Transaction Type Count by Fraud Status')

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud', loc='upper right')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
